game.title: Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly Remake
game.blurb: Horror adventure from Koei Tecmo, a remake of Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly (2003), released 2026-03-12. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Story
chapters.summary: The run of hidden achievements named like story chapters, in falling unlock order. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Sisters and Small Moments
chapters.summary: Holding Mayu's hand, photographing her, the Spirit Stone Radio, Photo Mode and outfits.

chapters.title: The Camera Obscura and Combat
chapters.summary: Enhancing the camera and filters, Type-00 film, Special Shots, Fatal Frames, Sneak and Multi Shots, Fatal Time and dodging.

chapters.title: Photographing Every Spirit
chapters.summary: Wraiths, specters, Revenants and twin dolls.

chapters.title: Documents and Charms
chapters.summary: Collecting every document and collecting and upgrading every charm.

chapters.title: Secret Goals
chapters.summary: Other hidden achievements whose conditions are secret on Steam.

chapters.title: Nightmare and Full Completion
chapters.summary: An ending on Nightmare difficulty and unlocking every achievement.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). This is the remake's own Steam app (3920610, "FATAL FRAME II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE"); RAWG keeps the 2003 original as a separate entry. RAWG lists PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. No StrategyWiki page under "Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly Remake" or "Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE". fatalframe.fandom.com has no page under "Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly Remake" but answers under "Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE", with only about 15 linked pages, including "Minakami Village", "Mayu Amakura", "Spirit Stones (FFII)" and "Doll List Sidequest"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 28 of 51 Steam achievements are hidden. 12 hidden ones look like chapter titles (from "The Lost Village" at 84% down to about 14%) and form the story chapter; the order of the last three is a guess from close unlock rates. The other 16 hidden ones (camera, protection and other names) go to Secret Goals because their conditions are secret.
